summary: Strong test suite with comprehensive coverage of all major requirements (parsing XML/JSON, aggregation, flaky detection, markdown rendering, CLI, workflow structure). Tests are well-organized across dedicated modules with clear separation of concerns. Good edge case coverage including error scenarios, status aliases, format dispatch, and exact output validation. Minor gaps: some boundary conditions untested (extreme values, empty results, very large files), temporal coupling in harness-assert (requires prior act run to pass), no performance tests, missing explicit test for GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY file output. Would reliably catch regressions in core functionality and integration paths.
